Name: Deploy IIS website
Description: Create or update an IIS website and its application pool on the target machine. The website content must already be on disk - place this step after a 'Deploy package' step that installs files into the physical path.

Properties.Name: Website
Properties.Description: Identity and content location of the IIS website

Properties.Name: Website name
Properties.Description: Name of the IIS website. It is created when missing and updated when it already exists.

Properties.Name: Physical path
Properties.Description: Folder on the target machine that holds the website content. Normally the 'Installation directory' of a preceding 'Deploy package' step. The folder is created when missing.

Properties.Name: Bindings
Properties.Description: Newline-separated list of bindings, one per line, in the format: protocol ip:port:hostname [certificate-thumbprint] [sni]. Use * for any IP and leave the hostname empty to match any host. HTTPS bindings require the thumbprint of a certificate already present in the LocalMachine\My store of the target machine; add the sni keyword to enable Server Name Indication (which also requires a hostname). Examples: 'http *:80:' or 'https *:443:app.example.com 1a2b3c4d5e6f sni'.

Properties.Name: Remove bindings that are not listed above
Properties.Description: If enabled, any binding on the website that is not listed above is removed. Otherwise existing bindings are left in place and the listed ones are added.

Properties.Name: Application pool
Properties.Description: Application pool the website runs in

Properties.Name: Application pool name
Properties.Description: Name of the application pool. It is created when missing and updated when it already exists.

Properties.Name: .NET CLR version
Properties.Description: Managed runtime version of the application pool. Choose 'No managed code' for ASP.NET Core applications that are hosted out-of-process.

Properties.Name: Managed pipeline mode
Properties.Description: Managed pipeline mode of the application pool.

Properties.Name: Enable 32-bit applications
Properties.Description: If enabled the application pool runs 32-bit worker processes on a 64-bit system.

Properties.Name: Identity
Properties.Description: The account the application pool worker process runs as.

Properties.Name: User account name
Properties.Description: Name of a specific Windows user account, e.g. DOMAIN\user or .\user. Make sure this account can read the physical path.

Properties.Name: Password
Properties.Description: Password for the specified Windows user account.

Properties.Name: Authentication
Properties.Description: IIS authentication modes for the website. Leave entries unchanged to keep whatever is already configured on the machine.

Properties.Name: Anonymous authentication
Properties.Description: Anonymous authentication.

Properties.Name: Windows authentication
Properties.Description: Windows authentication. The IIS 'Windows Authentication' role feature must be installed on the target machine.

Properties.Name: Basic authentication
Properties.Description: Basic authentication. The IIS 'Basic Authentication' role feature must be installed on the target machine.

Properties.Name: Options
Properties.Description: Behaviour of the step itself

Properties.Name: State after deployment
Properties.Description: State of the application pool and website once the step has finished.

Properties.Name: Retry attempts
Properties.Description: How many times each IIS operation is retried before the step fails. IIS configuration writes fail intermittently when another process holds applicationHost.config. Leave empty for the default of 5.
